apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: app-docker-secret

          image: registry:5000/private/hello:1.0
EOF
"}
